name: Fenrus the Devourer
summary: In Shadowfang Keep, Fenrus the Devourer prowls the upper sanctum. Archmage Arugal keeps the enormous worg as a pet and guardian, its body swollen by unnatural magic. Intruders seeking the archmage's study must face the beast and its master.

sections.title: A Beast in the Master's Study
sections.body: Fenrus the Devourer lurks outside Archmage Arugal's personal chambers deep within Shadowfang Keep. Unlike the worgen on the ramparts, Fenrus is a worg, swollen to enormous size. The beast prowls among the shelves, scrolls, and arcane apparatus in Arugal's private study. The archmage keeps Fenrus as both pet and guard against anyone who comes seeking his head.

sections.title: Corrupted Might
sections.body: Fenrus's unnatural bulk points to dark magic saturating the keep since Baron Silverlaine's downfall. Archmage Arugal or his unleashed worgen warped the creature through arcane or shadowy experiments, turning a native predator into a ravenous juggernaut. Fenrus is so feral and bound by magic that no hunter can charm or tame him.

sections.title: Arugal's Watchful Eye
sections.body: Disturbing Fenrus can mean death for the careless. When the worg spots an intruder, his ear-splitting howl rings through the fortress and draws Arugal's attention. The archmage projects his dark will into the chamber and summons voidwalkers to help Fenrus overwhelm and devour those who enter.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Fenrus?
faq.answer: Fenrus is an exceptionally large worg, a wolf-like predator native to Lordaeron, rather than a bipedal worgen. His unnatural bulk and viciousness come from prolonged exposure to the dark magic practiced in Shadowfang Keep.
Fenrus prowls the study chambers high inside Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. His lair lies directly along the approach to Archmage Arugal's inner redoubt.

faq.q: Can hunters tame Fenrus as a pet?
faq.answer: No. Though Fenrus is an ordinary beast by classification, hunters cannot tame him. His mind is broken and feral, bound to Archmage Arugal's dark will.

faq.q: Why does Arugal summon demons when Fenrus is attacked?
faq.answer: Arugal keeps Fenrus as a prized pet and the final guard before his sanctum. When Fenrus bellows as combat begins, Arugal intervenes and conjures voidwalkers into the chamber to overwhelm those threatening the beast.

faq.q: Why is Fenrus so much larger than normal worgs?
faq.answer: Fenrus's immense size is believed to come from Archmage Arugal's dark experiments, or from magical fallout from the worgen infestation overtaking the keep.

faq.q: What happens across the dungeon when Fenrus is engaged?
faq.answer: When Fenrus enters combat, he unleashes a thunderous roar heard anywhere inside Shadowfang Keep. It alerts all to the battle outside Arugal's door.

angles.text: Do not waste time trying to charm Fenrus. Shadowfang's dark arts have twisted his mind beyond repair, and the wild cannot bind him.
Archmage Arugal's voidwalkers show how deeply the former Dalaran mage has delved into forbidden shadow conjurations.
Fenrus is a grim sign of Archmage Arugal's fall: he uses arcane arts to warp wild beasts into grotesque household guards.
